headline: AI‑driven growth lifted revenues, but profit margins varied across the sector in Q2 FY27.
summary: Top‑line growth was strong for most majors, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY revenue jump. TCS and Tech Mahindra posted solid double‑digit revenue gains, while Infosys trimmed its FY guidance to 1‑2% growth. Profit margins were mixed; HCLTech improved operating margin to 18.2%, whereas Infosys and Wipro saw modest or declining net profit growth. Dividend payouts remained stable, with most firms increasing or maintaining payouts.

themes.title: AI as a revenue catalyst
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI‑related sales, with HCLTech reporting a 78% YoY AI revenue jump and TCS crossing $3.1 bn AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY revenue guidance to 1‑2% and saw operating margin stay flat, reflecting slower pricing power.

themes.title: Strong dividend commitment
themes.detail: Most companies declared or raised interim dividends, signalling confidence in cash flow.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY, EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY guidance was cut.
